A full-colour picture for the two facing pages of an open children's sticker album, wide 2:1, full bleed. The left half and the right half must each work as a complete picture on its own, because on a phone held upright the two halves are shown one above the other; a vertical strip about 6% wide down the exact middle is the book's fold and holds nothing important. It is a lovely, calm, lived-in place for arranging bird stickers on, so it is empty of birds, people and animals, with plenty of open, softly painted space spread across both halves (sky, grass, floor, water, wall) where stickers can sit and still stand out: keep the detail light and mid-toned there and let it gather richer around the edges and corners. A whole place rather than a game background: a wide view with depth, a clear time of day and small charming details to find. A tailor's shop window and street: a bow window full of coats, waistcoats and a dummy, a big button-shaped shop sign without words, a bench outside, a washing line in a back garden over the wall, breezy day.
